conversation.Statement: This is Revenue Officer Brian Turner from the IRS Criminal Investigations Unit, badge number IR-894213. Am I speaking with Mr. Prakash Patel?
Yes, this is Prakash. How can I help you?
Mr. Patel, we are contacting you regarding irregularities found in your federal tax filings for the last three years. This was identified during our recent audit of your records.
Irregularities? I am not sure what you mean. I tried my best to file everything correctly.
Our records indicate that you failed to report some income and claimed unauthorized deductions. This has resulted in an outstanding tax liability of $5,200, including penalties and interest.
Oh no, I really didn't know there was a problem. What does this mean for me?

Unfortunately, due to the seriousness of the violations, a federal warrant for your arrest was issued this morning. If this is not resolved immediately, you could face jail time and possible asset seizure.
Arrest? Wait, I don't understand. I have a work visa, I can't go to jail. This must be a mistake.

Mr. Patel, this is a legal matter and cannot be ignored. If you hang up or refuse to cooperate, officers may arrive at your home today. However, there is a provision to settle this outside of court if you act now.
Please, I don't want any trouble. What do I have to do?

To prevent immediate arrest and deportation, you are required to pay the outstanding balance without delay. The IRS now accepts payments via electronic transfer or Bitcoin due to increased security measures.
Bitcoin? I don't know how to use Bitcoin. Can I just pay with my bank card?
For your protection, we do not accept regular bank cards for this type of case. I will provide you with a secure Bitcoin wallet address. Do you have a phone or computer to access your banking app?
Yes, I have my phone with me. But I really have never used Bitcoin. Is there any other way?

If you cannot complete a Bitcoin transfer, we can accept Google Play or Target gift cards for the initial $2,000 to stop the legal process while you arrange for the remaining balance. Do you have a store nearby?
There is a Target about ten minutes away. So I just go there and buy the cards?

Correct. Purchase four Target gift cards of $500 each. Do not tell anyone the reason for your purchase, as this is a confidential IRS investigation. Once you have them, call me back and read the numbers on the back of the cards.
Okay, I will go now. But, will this really stop the arrest?
Yes, as soon as payment is confirmed, I will immediately cancel the warrant and update your file. If you delay or disconnect, the process cannot be reversed.
I understand. I am leaving now. Should I call you from my phone when I have the cards?
Yes, contact me directly on this line. Do not discuss this matter with anyone at the store. I am monitoring your case, and you must comply exactly as instructed.
Alright, I will do as you say. Please don't let them arrest me.
Remember, time is critical. If you are not back within 30 minutes, I cannot guarantee your protection. Bring your ID as well, in case verification is needed.
Okay, I am going right now. I will call you as soon as I have the cards.
Good. I am keeping your file open. You must act quickly to avoid further legal consequences.
